Identifiable river/watershed portions may be reconstructed; unresolved portions must remain uncertainty corridors rather than an invented line.

geometry.derivationNote: The 16 June 1861 protocol states that Russian and Qing commissioners verified and exchanged matching maps and detailed descriptions and made them an additional article to the Peking Treaty. The companion official description supplies the natural-boundary logic and post sequence E/I/K/L/N/O/P/T. Legal route semantics are therefore source-verified. Geometry is intentionally not promoted to geometry-verified until the exchanged maps and the later post-placement description with historical coordinates are transcribed/georeferenced.
